rules.statement: The environment includes an APB Requester model driving legal/illegal requests with varied idle time, and a TL-UL device model delaying a_ready and d_valid, answering in acceptance cycle, injecting d_error, wrong opcode, wrong source and orphan responses.
The APB protocol checker and the TL-UL protocol checker of REF-005 are bound at the ports.
A scoreboard compares each TL-UL request and each APB completion with the APB transfer that caused it.
Each simulation run records its seed.
Every requirement in section 3 is covered by at least one passing test and all coverage bins of 15.3 are hit.

rules.condition: during reset and after reset release
rules.statement: All listed outputs are 0 in reset, including o_tlul_a_opcode, o_tlul_a_address and o_tlul_a_data; o_tlul_d_ready becomes 1 at the first edge after release.

rules.condition: aligned write with PSTRB=4'b1111 to a prompt device
rules.statement: Bridge issues PutFullData, size 2, mask 4'b1111 with correct address and data, completes in 3 Access cycles, and PRDATA is 0.
Scoreboard matches every TL-UL request and APB completion for random aligned reads and writes.

rules.condition: write with PSTRB other than 4'b1111, or access with PADDR[1:0] nonzero
rules.statement: No TL-UL request is issued; PREADY and PSLVERR are asserted in the first Access cycle and PRDATA is 0.
Bridge issues Get, ignores PSTRB, PRDATA equals d_data, and completes in 3 Access cycles.

rules.condition: response with d_error = 1 on read or write
rules.statement: PSLVERR is 1 and PRDATA is 0.
PSLVERR is 1 and PRDATA is 0.

rules.condition: random a_ready delays of 0 to 8 cycles
rules.statement: Channel A is stable while valid and not ready, and the request is accepted once.

rules.condition: d_valid pulses while idle, before acceptance, or after the response
rules.statement: Orphan responses are discarded, have no APB effect, and the next transfer is correct.
Transfer takes 2 Access cycles.

rules.condition: reset during A1, A2 or A3
rules.statement: Both FSMs are idle after release and no completion is produced for the abandoned transfer.

rules.condition: back-to-back transfers with random idle gaps
rules.statement: Only one request is outstanding and intervals are as in 10.4.
Legal parameter values elaborate; illegal values are reported.
Both protocol checkers are bound and report no checker error in any run.
Lint reports no finding and CDC reports zero crossings.
Every non-constant output is driven by a flip-flop Q pin and module boundaries are as in 14.2.
Design contains no latch, loop, tri-state or gated clock.

rules.condition: back-to-back transfers with psel held 1 and only penable changing, with or without idle cycles
rules.statement: Every transfer completes correctly in order, Setup-to-Setup intervals are as in 10.4, and no TL-UL request is made for illegal ones.
o_apb_pready is asserted only with i_apb_psel and i_apb_penable, for one cycle; o_apb_pslverr only with o_apb_pready.
Channel A remains stable.
At most one TL-UL request is outstanding.
Opcode, size, mask and address are legal per REF-005 legalAOpcode, sizeMatchesMask, addrSizeAligned, contigMask.
a_param, a_size, a_mask, a_source and a_user are constant.
o_tlul_d_ready is 0 in reset and 1 from the first edge after release.
No TL-UL request is issued for an illegal APB request.
o_tlul_a_valid rises in the cycle after the legal Setup phase.
An orphan response never changes o_apb_pready, o_apb_prdata or o_apb_pslverr.

rules.condition: i_apb_psel=1, i_apb_penable=0, APB FSM idle, including directly after a PREADY cycle
rules.statement: Next cycle has o_tlul_a_valid = 1 for a legal request or o_apb_pready = 1 for an illegal request.
Coverage COV-001 to COV-005 define bins (PSTRB values, error kinds, wait/delay cycles, orphan timing, back-to-back pairs) and all bins must be hit.
Checkers sample channel A only while o_tlul_a_valid is 1.
Formal verification is not required; verification is by simulation and assertions only.
